summary.text: Carolyn Eslick represents the 39th Legislative District in the Washington House of Representatives and lives in Sultan. Her official page says she was appointed to the House in 2017 and later elected, and that she is Ranking Member of the Early Learning & Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Eslick grew up on a farm and was a restaurant owner for more than 20 years, according to her official page.
It says she founded and helped manage GROW Washington, a business development and retail incubator.
The page says she served on the Sultan City Council and then more than nine years as mayor of Sultan before being appointed to the state House in 2017.
It says she has focused on behavioral health, housing and public safety, and lists her as also serving on the Capital Budget and Education committees.
The page lists recognition including 2025 Legislator of the Year from the National Alliance on Mental Illness.
